description: Deliver one line to the human who owns this key, in person: their 3D companion walks onto the browser tab they have open, gestures, and says it, with an optional link to click through. Use this for the handful of moments that deserve to interrupt someone (a long task finished, a decision is needed, something broke), not for progress chatter: the client applies an importance floor, a rate limit, quiet hours and dedupe, so noise is dropped rather than queued. The message is always delivered to the key owner and nobody else. If no browser is open it expires quietly in about five minutes; the durable record is the notification inbox, not this. Returns the queued announcement and how long it stays deliverable.

emote.description: Gesture the avatar arrives with. Rigs without it fall back to a wave.

from.description: Who it is from, spoken as attribution ("your build", "Stripe", the agent's name).

importance.description: 0-100, default 70. The client drops anything under its floor (50 by default) and only lets 90+ through quiet hours. Use 90+ for something broken or blocking, 60-80 for a finished task, under 50 for something that can wait for the inbox.

key.description: Dedupe key. Two announcements sharing a key are said once, so a retrying job can call this every attempt without repeating itself.

text.description: The line to say out loud. One sentence. Write it as speech, not as a log line.

tone.description: Colours the bubble and picks a default gesture. Default alert.

url.description: Where clicking through goes: an absolute https URL or a three.ws path.

name: announce
title: Tell your human, in person
